notes: D&A (historical 'da') uses the Consolidated Statements of Operations line item 'Depreciation and amortization expense' (GAAP) rather than the cash flow reconciliation adjustment. ([cognizant.q4cdn.com](https://cognizant.q4cdn.com/123993165/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/CTSH-2025-12-31-10K_Final-web.pdf))

Capex (historical 'capex') is 'Purchases of property and equipment' from the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows, entered as an absolute value. ([cognizant.q4cdn.com](https://cognizant.q4cdn.com/123993165/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/CTSH-2025-12-31-10K_Final-web.pdf))

NWC construction: (Total current assets - cash and cash equivalents - short-term investments) - (Total current liabilities - short-term debt), using reported balance sheet components from the FY2023–FY2025 filings. ([cognizant.q4cdn.com](https://cognizant.q4cdn.com/123993165/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/CTSH-2025-12-31-10K_Final-web.pdf))

Tax rate: base-case tax_rate is the FY2025 effective tax rate computed as income tax provision / income before provision for income taxes. ([cognizant.q4cdn.com](https://cognizant.q4cdn.com/123993165/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/CTSH-2025-12-31-10K_Final-web.pdf))

WACC: model-built using (i) beta from TipRanks, (ii) cost of debt derived from FY2025 interest expense and average total debt, and (iii) risk-free rate approximated near early March 2026 10Y yields; equity risk premium is assumed (not disclosed in filings). ([tipranks.com](https://www.tipranks.com/stocks/ctsh))

NOL utilization percent is not disclosed in a usable percentage form in the referenced filings; set to null and left for the downstream tax model to specify. ([cognizant.q4cdn.com](https://cognizant.q4cdn.com/123993165/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/CTSH-2025-12-31-10K_Final-web.pdf))

Comps multiples use TipRanks' enterprise value/revenue and enterprise value/EBITDA and P/E measures; TipRanks does not clearly label these as NTM/forward in the extracted snippets, so they are treated as proxies rather than strict NTM values.

catalysts: Acceleration beyond FY2026 guidance if AI-led large deals and bookings convert into sustained revenue growth and operating leverage. ([news.cognizant.com](https://news.cognizant.com/2026-02-04-Cognizant-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results))

Further margin expansion if NextGen savings and operational efficiencies offset any labor/cost pressure. ([cognizant.q4cdn.com](https://cognizant.q4cdn.com/123993165/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/CTSH-2025-12-31-10K_Final-web.pdf))

Deal activity and integration success (e.g., Belcan contribution) could broaden revenue growth and capability mix. ([cognizant.q4cdn.com](https://cognizant.q4cdn.com/123993165/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/CTSH-2025-12-31-10K_Final-web.pdf))
company_overview: Cognizant is a global professional services company reporting across four segments: Financial Services, Health Sciences, Products and Resources, and Communications, Media and Technology. ([cognizant.q4cdn.com](https://cognizant.q4cdn.com/123993165/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/CTSH-2025-12-31-10K_Final-web.pdf))

For FY2025, Cognizant reported revenue of $21.108B with GAAP income from operations (EBIT) of $3.389B (operating margin ~16.1%). ([cognizant.q4cdn.com](https://cognizant.q4cdn.com/123993165/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/CTSH-2025-12-31-10K_Final-web.pdf))

Management emphasizes AI-led growth and deal execution, supported by operational initiatives (e.g., NextGen) that have supported margin performance. ([cognizant.q4cdn.com](https://cognizant.q4cdn.com/123993165/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/CTSH-2025-12-31-10K_Final-web.pdf))
current_context: In the Feb 4, 2026 results release, Cognizant guided FY2026 constant-currency revenue growth of 4.0% to 6.5% and adjusted operating margin of 15.9% to 16.1% (10 to 30 bps of expansion). ([news.cognizant.com](https://news.cognizant.com/2026-02-04-Cognizant-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results))

FY2025 revenue was $21.108B and adjusted operating margin was ~15.8% (GAAP operating margin ~16.1%); management highlighted AI builder strategy execution and strong large-deal momentum. ([news.cognizant.com](https://news.cognizant.com/2026-02-04-Cognizant-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results))

Cognizant reiterated capital return activity (dividend increase and share repurchases) alongside free cash flow conversion during FY2025. ([news.cognizant.com](https://news.cognizant.com/2026-02-04-Cognizant-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth is anchored to FY2026 guidance (mid-single digits in constant currency) and then gently decelerates through FY2030 to reflect service-cycle maturity. ([news.cognizant.com](https://news.cognizant.com/2026-02-04-Cognizant-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results))

Base-case EBIT margin holds near the company’s recent operating margin regime (~16%), consistent with management’s FY2026 adjusted operating margin range and continued operational rigor. ([news.cognizant.com](https://news.cognizant.com/2026-02-04-Cognizant-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results))

Capital intensity remains modest: historical capex is ~1.4%–1.6% of sales and D&A is ~2.6%–2.8% of sales, supporting stable cash conversion assumptions. ([cognizant.q4cdn.com](https://cognizant.q4cdn.com/123993165/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/CTSH-2025-12-31-10K_Final-web.pdf))

Working capital needs are modeled as a low single-digit percent of sales using a consistent NWC build from reported current assets/liabilities (excluding cash and short-term investments). ([cognizant.q4cdn.com](https://cognizant.q4cdn.com/123993165/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/CTSH-2025-12-31-10K_Final-web.pdf))
key_risks: Weaker-than-expected client re-acceleration could reduce revenue growth and dilute operating leverage versus the base-case trajectory. ([news.cognizant.com](https://news.cognizant.com/2026-02-04-Cognizant-Reports-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results))

Margin risk from compensation inflation, delivery mix shifts, or disruption in large-deal ramp timing could pressure EBIT margin. ([cognizant.q4cdn.com](https://cognizant.q4cdn.com/123993165/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/CTSH-2025-12-31-10K_Final-web.pdf))

Working-capital volatility (collections / incentives / deferred revenue dynamics) may cause differences between modeled and realized FCF conversion. ([cognizant.q4cdn.com](https://cognizant.q4cdn.com/123993165/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/CTSH-2025-12-31-10K_Final-web.pdf))

valuation_summary: The DCF uses an explicit driver framework (revenue growth, EBIT margin, D&A %, capex %, and NWC %) that is tied directly to the last three fiscal-year GAAP trends and FY2026 guidance. ([cognizant.q4cdn.com](https://cognizant.q4cdn.com/123993165/files/doc_financials/2025/q4/CTSH-2025-12-31-10K_Final-web.pdf))

Terminal value assumptions (terminal growth and an EV/EBITDA-style exit multiple) are set to be economically conservative relative to peak multiple regimes for IT services. (Model input assumption; not directly disclosed in filings.)
